name: Parth Sarthi
role: Data Architect · Platform Modernisation · Technical & Delivery Leadership

projects.name: Enterprise data platform
projects.title: A foundation that serves more than one business.
projects.summary: An enterprise data platform supporting multiple business domains through shared architecture.
projects.metricLabel: shared enterprise data foundation across multiple business areas
projects.problem: Teams across several business domains needed a common data foundation spanning ingestion, warehousing, and downstream analytics.
projects.ownership: Primary solution architect, from initial design through platform evolution and delivery.
decisions: Designed reusable, restartable, metadata-driven ETL patterns to support scalable onboarding.
Architected AWS pipelines orchestrated through Airflow, with Redshift and PostgreSQL warehouse models.
Integrated source-to-target testing with issue-tracking evidence and established CI/CD and regression processes.
Replaced access-key-based access with IAM role-based authentication and optimised EMR configurations for workload needs.
projects.execution: Collaborated with business stakeholders on platform and supply-chain solution design. Translated requirements into delivery backlogs, Agile/Scrum execution, data-quality controls, and SLA governance.
projects.outcome: Established a shared enterprise data foundation and reusable ingestion and modelling patterns across multiple business domains; workload optimisation improved infrastructure utilisation.

projects.name: Platform modernisation
projects.category: From legacy ETL to managed platforms
projects.title: Modernisation is a sequence of decisions.
projects.summary: 1,000+ legacy ETL jobs migrated to AWS / Airflow, with ongoing evolution toward Databricks.
projects.role: Migration lead; contributor to ongoing Databricks modernisation
projects.status: AWS / Airflow complete · Databricks in progress
projects.metricLabel: Talend ETL jobs migrated to AWS / Airflow
projects.problem: A large Talend ETL estate needed more maintainable orchestration and reusable cloud engineering patterns.
projects.ownership: Led the migration of 1,000+ Talend jobs to an AWS-based Airflow framework. Currently supporting the next stage of platform modernisation toward Databricks.
decisions: Moved legacy ETL workloads into an AWS-based Apache Airflow framework.
Established reusable pipeline patterns and engineering standards for production workloads.
Supported team capability through mentoring and code reviews.
Now supporting the evolution of orchestration and processing toward managed Databricks capabilities.
projects.execution: Combined ETL leadership, complex SQL development and warehouse modelling with cloud-framework delivery. The next platform phase is an ongoing contribution rather than a completed migration claim.
projects.outcome: Completed migration of 1,000+ ETL jobs to AWS / Airflow. The subsequent Databricks initiative is in progress; no completion or performance claims are made for that phase.

projects.name: Commercial & healthcare analytics
projects.title: A common language for business performance.
projects.summary: 10+ governed data marts connecting commercial and healthcare analytics to consistent KPIs and Tableau reporting.
projects.metricLabel: governed data marts forming the Tableau semantic layer
projects.problem: Commercial and medical analytics required consistent business definitions across markets and reporting use cases.
projects.ownership: Architect for an enterprise analytics layer, and primary technical contact for platform architecture, data quality, and delivery.
decisions: Built 10+ governed data marts as the semantic layer for Tableau reporting.
Standardised business logic and metric definitions for commercial sales and market-performance KPIs.
Designed dimensional models for healthcare-domain analytics and related operational measures.
Governed master-data mappings, data quality, and pipeline reliability across enterprise analytics workflows.
projects.execution: Connected stakeholder needs with data models, aggregation strategies, and semantic delivery. Governed product and domain reference data across enterprise reporting.
projects.outcome: Enabled commercial and healthcare analytics through a governed semantic layer, with 10+ data marts supporting consistent downstream reporting.
flow: 10+ governed data marts · Shared KPI definitions

projects.name: Supply-chain analytics
projects.title: Reliable delivery data, built around real calendars.
projects.summary: Calendar-aware pipelines for expected-delivery calculations and supply-chain reporting.
projects.problem: Supply-chain reporting depends on expected delivery dates that reflect operational calendars and transit time.
projects.ownership: Data engineering and delivery-date processing logic for supply-chain reporting.
decisions: Incorporated warehouse holidays, public holidays, transit time, and delivery-calendar dependencies into expected-date calculations.
Transformed operational and logistics data into analytics-ready datasets.
Created pipelines to calculate and track delivery-performance measures.
projects.execution: Collaborated with stakeholders on solution design and delivered data-engineering work for supply-chain analytics.
projects.outcome: Enabled supply-chain performance reporting with delivery-date calculations that account for operational calendars and transit time.

milestones: Joined TCS in December, following a B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering at SJBIT, VTU.
Digital Cadre designation in February 2019; promoted to IT Analyst in February 2020.
Began an onsite enterprise client engagement through TCS, working directly with business stakeholders.
Promoted to Assistant Consultant in November 2023; ongoing platform architecture and portfolio leadership.
